neighbours.label: A section of a work that frames the main text from outside: prologue, epilogue, preamble, foreword, prelude; ordinary parts of a work stay quiet
fire: Critics praised the prologue for setting the tone early.
The novel's epilogue jumps forward twenty years.
She played a Chopin Prelude at the recital.
The preamble to the treaty lists its aims.
The editor added a short foreword to the reprint.
The film opens with a prologue set in ancient Rome.
An epilogue explains what happened to the survivors.
The preamble of the charter was read aloud.
quiet: Critics praised the ending for setting the tone early.
The novel's middle jumps forward twenty years.
She played a Chopin Waltz at the recital.
The text of the treaty lists its aims.
The editor added a short glossary to the reprint.
The film opens with a battle set in ancient Rome.
A footnote explains what happened to the survivors.
The index of the charter was read aloud.

notes: Card: 'ilogue' x6, 'logue' x5, ' Prelude' x4, 'reamble' x4, 'word' x4, ' preamble' x3, French préamb-ule. Probe: prologue 0.97, Prelude 0.90, preamble 0.80, epilogue 0.62, foreword 0.39; chapter, final scene, Concerto, index, appendix at most 0.01. Appendix being quiet means 'outside the main text' is not enough; the framing has to be at the start or the close.
